result.title: MKA: Evaluating Multimodal Knowledge Agents on end-to-end professional tasks
result.summary: We introduce the Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) benchmark, which measures how well autonomous agents perform end-to-end professional knowledge work that depends on visual understanding. Each task requires an agent to extract and combine information from multiple visually dense files, such as CAD blueprints, electronics schematics, radiographs, complex charts and geospatial maps, and to produce a standalone deliverable in .xlsx, .pptx, .pdf, .docx, .html or .png format. Existing benchmarks leave this capability largely untested: removing image-viewing tools leaves Gemini 4 Carbon's score on GDPval unchanged, and single-format evaluations such as GDP$.$pdf and GDP$.$xlsx do not require reasoning across files or modalities. MKA contains 200 tasks across 10 economic sectors. Deliverables are graded against expert-weighted rubrics by a sandboxed agentic autorater that agrees with human domain experts on 96.2% of criterion judgments in our expert-graded study (Cohen's $κ= 0.91$), scored by weighted satisfaction rate (WSR) overall and on frontier criteria unsaturated by prior-generation models (Climb-WSR). Across the frontier models we evaluate (Gemini 4 Carbon, Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Opus 5.5, and GPT-6 Astra), Claude Fable 5.2 (56.6% Climb-WSR, 73.3% Overall WSR) and Gemini 4 Carbon (54.3% Climb-WSR, 71.9% Overall WSR) achieve the highest scores, while Carbon uses $5.7\times$ fewer tokens. Even for the strongest models, Climb-WSR remains below 57%, leaving substantial headroom for multimodal agents.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MKA 基准，含 200 个覆盖 10 个经济部门的端到端专业任务，要求 agent 从 CAD 图纸、电路图、影像、图表、地图等视觉密集文件中提取并整合信息，再产出 xlsx/pptx/pdf 等交付物；评分由专家加权 rubric 与 agentic autorater 完成，并报告 Climb-WSR 与 token 成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 多文件视觉证据的提取、筛选与跨模态整合正是主线中的证据获取问题，且「移除看图工具不改变得分」的诊断可供核查视觉旁路与模型是否真正使用视觉证据；但任务是交付物生成，未触及内部状态或 latent 生成，机制层面的可用信息有限。
